name: farday-roshan-sand
description: سیستم مدیریت شرکت تولیدی فردای روشن (سنگ، کرش، جغل و ریگ) — آفلاین و محلی

scripts.build: npm run build -w @farday/api && npm run build -w @farday/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @farday/web && npx tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.seed:demo: npm run build -w @farday/api && npm run db:seed:demo -w @farday/api --
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build -w @farday/api && npm run build -w @farday/web
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build:desktop && npm run package:api && tauri build
scripts.test:ui: node scripts/ui-check/layout.test.mjs && node scripts/ui-check/dom.test.mjs && node scripts/ui-check/sidebar.test.mjs && node scripts/ui-check/theme.test.mjs && node scripts/ui-check/form.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:ui && node scripts/ui-check/routes.test.mjs && npm run test:guards && npm run test:nsis && npm run test:tauri && npm run test:api && npm run test:scenario && npm run test:packaged
